defsZh:
vi. 變寬, 擴大
vt. 放寬, 使擴大

examples.en: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
examples.zh: 再要開眼界，去看人民廣場下面的地下商場。

defsEn: make broader

defsZh:
n. 球莖, 電燈泡
[醫] 球, 鱗莖, 球莖

examples.zh: 燈泡發光。
三個燈泡燒壞了。

examples.en: Yanni put the light bulb in a box.
examples.zh: 雅尼將燈泡放入箱子。

defsEn: a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure

defsZh:
[化] (公司、社團等的)內部章程; 附則; 細則
[經] 公司章程附則

n. 愉快, 振奮, 歡呼
vi. 歡呼, 喝彩, 快活起來
vt. 使振奮, 歡呼

examples.zh: 那些花兒安慰了她。

examples.en: After hearing the news, she cheered up.
examples.zh: 聽到這個訊息，她開心了起來。

examples.en: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
examples.zh: 情況正在改善，所以振作起來！

defsEn: a cry or shout of approval

defsZh:
n. 複雜化, 複雜情況
[醫] 併發症, 併發病

examples.en: The emergence of a third gender has added legal and administrative complications, creating unnecessary burdens.
examples.zh: 第三性別的出現增加了法律和行政上的麻煩，徒增無謂的負擔。

defsEn: the act or process of complicating

defsZh: a. 體貼的, 體諒的, 考慮周到的

examples.zh: 你真體貼。

examples.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
examples.zh: 你考慮周到，沒有打擾我們。

defsEn: showing concern for the rights and feelings of others

defsZh: n. 白天, 日間

examples.zh: 那時是白天。

examples.en: The thieves knocked off another bank today in a daytime robbery.
examples.zh: 今天強盜大白天的就搶了另一家銀行。

examples.en: The Summer Solstice is the day with the longest daytime hours of the year.
examples.zh: 夏至是一年中，日晝時間最長的一天。

defsEn: the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside

defsZh: n. 裝飾, 裝飾品
defsEn: something used to beautify

defsZh:
vt. 丟棄, 拋棄
vi. 墊牌
n. 墊牌, 拋棄

examples.zh: 丟棄一張手牌。
他的計劃被駁回了。

examples.en: No women like to wear a dress that another discarded. With men, they're not so choosy.
examples.zh: 沒有女人會喜歡穿二手裙子；可是二手男人呢，她們卻照要不誤。

defsEn: anything that is cast aside or discarded

defsZh: adv. 激烈地, 徹底地

examples.zh: 在這期間，情況發生了巨大變化。

examples.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
examples.zh: 在這期間，情況發生了巨大變化。

examples.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
examples.zh: 他們壟斷了原物料供應，並開天價。

defsEn: in a drastic manner

defsZh:
vt. 抹去, 擦掉
[計] 清洗; 擦除; 抹除; DOS內部命令:從磁碟上刪除一個或多個檔案

examples.zh: 黑板需要擦擦了。

examples.en: He wishes to erase bad memories.
examples.zh: 他希望抹去不好的記憶。

examples.en: He erased his speech from the tape.
examples.zh: 他把他的那段話從磁帶裡刪除了。

defsEn: remove from memory or existence

defsZh:
n. 探險家, 探測者, 勘探器
[醫] 探察器

examples.en: Early explorers used the stars for navigation.
examples.zh: 古代的探險家用星星來辨別方向。

examples.en: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
examples.zh: 探險家們在洞穴裡發現了骸骨。

defsEn: someone who travels into little known regions (especially for some scientific purpose)

defsZh:
a. 事實的, 實際的
[法] 事實的, 與事實有關的, 實際的

examples.en: I believe that it's not factual.
That book is full of factual errors.

defsEn: existing in act or fact

defsZh:
n. 固定(狀態), 固定物, 裝置
[計] 夾具

examples.en: Tom installed a new light fixture.
He was a fixture at the local mosque.
He was called to fix a broken light fixture.

defsEn: an object firmly fixed in place (especially in a household)

defsZh: n. 鞋類, 靴類
defsEn: clothing worn on a person's feet

defsZh: n. 型別, 流派

examples.en: What genres of music are you into?
examples.zh: 你喜歡哪種型別的音樂？

defsEn: a kind of literary or artistic work

defsZh:
n. 健身房, 體育館
[醫] 體育館, 健身室, 運動場

examples.en: He could be in the gymnasium.
Tom could be in the gymnasium.

defsEn: a school for students intermediate between elementary school and college; usually grades 9 to 12

defsZh: adv. 因此, 據此

examples.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 我們ACME有限公司，特此宣佈，我們將盡我們的力量抵制這種惡意收購。

defsEn: (formal) by means of this

defsZh:
n. 猶豫, 躊躇, 含糊, 口吃, 暫停
[計] 暫停

examples.en: I would marry you without hesitation.
examples.zh: 我會毫不猶豫嫁給你。

examples.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
examples.zh: 猶豫了片刻之後，他把書放在了桌子上。

examples.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
examples.zh: 他毫不猶豫地把自己的車賣了。

defsEn: indecision in speech or action

defsZh: a. 自制的, 國產的
defsEn: made or produced in the home or by yourself

defsZh: n. 款待, 親切, 殷勤

examples.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
examples.zh: 所有的客人都被她的好客感動了。

defsEn: kindness in welcoming guests or strangers

defsZh:
a. 進來的, 剛開始的, 新來的
n. 進來

examples.en: Sami and Layla were incoming freshmen.
Yanni almost ran into an incoming car.

defsEn: the act of entering

defsZh:
n. 歸納法, 感應, 就職, 入門
[計] 歸納法

examples.en: Induction cookers use magnets to directly heat pots and pans.
The rock star's induction into the Hall of Fame was predicted by all.

defsEn: a formal entry into an organization or position or office

defsZh:
n. 靈感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙計, 吸氣
[醫] 吸[氣]

examples.zh: 我丟了我的靈感。
我靈感枯竭了。

examples.en: Suddenly she had a brilliant inspiration.
examples.zh: 她突然有了一個絕妙的靈感。

defsEn: arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity

defsZh: adv. 一心一意地, 心無旁物地, 專心地
defsEn: with strained or eager attention

defsZh: n. 刈草的人, 刈草機
defsEn: garden tool for mowing grass on lawns

defsZh:
n. 營養, 營養學
[醫] 營養, 營養品

examples.en: She is careful about her child's nutrition.
examples.zh: 她很關心孩子的營養問題。

defsEn: (physiology) the organic process of nourishing or being nourished; the processes by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance

defsZh:
n. 再宣告, 重述
[經] 重報, 重新陳述, 再宣告
defsEn: a revised statement

defsZh: n. 轎車, 轎子
defsEn: a car that is closed and that has front and rear seats and two or four doors

defsZh: n. (防曬油中的)遮光劑

examples.zh: 塗點防曬吧。

defsEn: a cream spread on the skin; contains a chemical (as PABA) to filter out ultraviolet light and so protect from sunburn

defsZh: n. 健康

examples.en: It is a stunning exhibition on wellness and holistic healing from awe-inspiring India.

defsEn: a healthy state of wellbeing free from disease

defsZh:
n. 輔助練習冊, 工作規程書, 工作記事簿, 筆記本, 工作手冊
[計] 工作簿
defsEn: a student's book or booklet containing problems with spaces for solving them

defsZh: n. 書架, 書櫃

examples.zh: 約翰組裝了書架。

examples.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
examples.zh: 這個書架組裝起來很簡單。

examples.en: The bookcase is level with the table.
examples.zh: 書架和桌子齊平。

defsEn: a piece of furniture with shelves for storing books

defsZh: n. 清潔, 乾淨
defsEn: the habit of keeping free of superficial imperfections

defsZh:
n. 競爭者
[法] 爭辯者, 競爭者

examples.en: Linda is one of the contestants in the pageant.
examples.zh: 琳達是大會的參賽者之一。

defsEn: a person who participates in competitions

defsZh:
n. 道德規範
[醫] 倫理學

examples.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
examples.zh: 議員受到了議會道德委員會的譴責。

defsEn: motivation based on ideas of right and wrong

defsZh:
a. 有益健康的, 使人健康的, 衛生的
[法] 有益健康的, 健康的, 衛生的

examples.en: My goats are more healthful than this man's oxen will ever be.
More Vietnamese citizens are looking for food products that are healthful.

defsEn: conducive to good health of body or mind

defsZh:
a. 無效率的, 無能的
[醫] 無效的, 無效力的

examples.zh: 你們的效率太低了。

defsEn: not producing desired results; wasteful

defsZh:
n. 公升
[化] 升

examples.en: I drink 1.7 liters of water each day.
examples.zh: 我每天喝1.7升水。

examples.en: Last month, we collected five liters of rainwater.
examples.zh: 上個月我們收集了五升雨水。

examples.en: This bottle is able to contain two liters of hot water.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子可以裝兩升熱水。

defsEn: a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints)

defsZh:
n. 後退, 凹處, 衰退, 歸還
[醫] 退縮

examples.en: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
examples.zh: 經濟不景氣失業率上升到了5％。

defsEn: the state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year
